scope: Published Standard rates, up to 272K input tokens; comparison at equal token counts, not measured task cost or subscription quota consumption. USD figures are listed rates before any applicable taxes.
notes: The retained Astra benchmark used gpt-6-astra, not gpt-5.6-astra.
Medium/high are reasoning settings, not separate per-token model price bands. Total task cost depends on actual input, caching, output/reasoning usage, retries, execution mode and service tier.
Codex credits have no separate cache-write charge. Included subscription usage is not determined solely by purchased-credit rates.
This uses historical GPT-5.6 Luna, not newer GPT-6 Luna.

illustrative_gbp.warning: Illustration only, not a live exchange-rate quote; excludes any applicable VAT. Multiply by 1.20 if 20% UK VAT applies.
